name: The Mafia's Innocent Lover
overview: The ruthless gang boss Rafael Moretti has a secret love for Sophia. During an unexpected casino robbery, Rafael Moretti found Sophia, the girl he had been looking for, and they had a one-night stand by accident. Sophia borrowed money for her father's surgery expenses, which led Rafael to mistakenly believe that she was a gold digger, so he proposed a contractual relationship.
